description: Divisional Secretariate Tissamaharamaya - Divisional Secretary  of Thissamaharama do here by declare the mentioned Period to be the Period during which the Tissamaharama Pilgrimage regulation of 1952 shall be in face June 2nd to June 08th 2017
categorisation: This gazette content declares the period during which the Tissamaharama Pilgrimage Regulations of 1952 shall be in force. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the enforcement of existing regulations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, commercial activities, elections, public service, judicial appointments, or other specialized categories that would take precedence.
